evidence.note: The phrase הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת יֶרֶד identifies Jared as the son Mahalalel fathered.
וַיֵּרֶד describes Yahweh coming down to see the city and illustrates the sense of the proposed root.

name: יֶרֶד
summary: Genesis names Jared as Mahalalel’s son. His name shares its consonants with יָרַד, “go down,” though the genealogy gives no explanation of the name.
